newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soy markets shut for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian soy markets shut for holiday.

text.p: India's soy markets were closed on Wednesday for a national holiday and will reopen on Thursday, traders said.
On Tuesday, soybean and soyoil prices were steady but soymeal and rapeseed extraction prices fell on reduced export demand, they said.

Soymeal yellow was $280 per tonne in export for November, December and January shipment for new season crop. Rapeseed extraction was $125 per tonne in export. Rapeseed extraction was 4,300 rupees FOR Bedibunder and was 4,250 rupees FOR Bhavnagar.
